ai_summary: Aye Finance Limited has informed stock exchanges and shareholders about the successful dispatch of its 33rd Annual General Meeting (AGM) notice and Annual Report for FY2025-26, fulfilling SEBI Listing Regulations by providing web-links to access documents for all eligible shareholders. The virtual AGM is scheduled for September 1, 2026, with remote e-voting available from August 29-31, 2026, to ensure broad shareholder participation. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, outlining standard procedures for transparency and shareholder engagement, with no immediate red flags identified.
